newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse delays automated trading by a week.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse delays automated trading by a week.

text.p: Automated trading at the Tunis Stock Exchange, scheduled to start on Monday, has been delayed by a week, bourse sources said.
Traders said they were continuing simulations on the new system, installed in cooperation with the Paris bourse.
"The system is technically ready, but the trading start was postponed to October 28 to allow more time for the new rules to go into effect," one broker said.
On the Tunis bourse, with a turnover in 1995 of 918 million dinars ($937 million) and a capitalisation of 3.66 billion dinars ($3.73 billion), prices are currently displayed on notice boards.
The new system, already approved by the finance ministry, is aimed at attracting more private capital and company listings to the Tunis share market.
